lines.text: 他不会出卖任何人来换自己的前途。
lines.en: He won't sell anybody out to buy his future!
lines.note: 斯莱德上校听证会上的怒吼核心：把人格写进传世金句。

lines.text: 如果我还是五年前的我——我会拿喷火器把这地方烧了！
lines.en: If I were the man I was five years ago, I'd take a FLAMETHROWER to this place!
lines.note: 法兰克学校的怒吼；IMDb quotes 可查。

lines.text: 如今我走到人生的十字路口。我永远知道哪条路是对的——毫无例外，我都知道。但我从不走。你知道为什么吗？因为太难了。
lines.en: Now I have come to the crossroads in my life. I always knew what the right path was. Without exception, I knew. But I never took it. You know why? It was too damn hard.
lines.note: 法兰克的陈词（节选，原文含粗口）；IMDb quotes 可查。
